reasons.plausibility: It leverages established machine-learning interatomic potential methods that can reliably approximate DFT-level accuracy with some manageable uncertainties, so it is scientifically sound with minor issues.
reasons.testability: It specifies a direct comparison of predicted free energies and derived thermodynamic properties against high-accuracy ab initio or experimental results with a clear numerical threshold for falsification.
reasons.usefulness: If successful, the proposed approach would significantly accelerate the estimation of high-temperature free energies for complex alloys, addressing a key cost barrier in fusion materials research.
